kind: small purposive condition-masked AI review pilot
comparison: ordinary rewrite prompt versus the same prompt plus the updated skill instructions
model: same inherited writer model; provider model ID and sampling settings not exposed
source_selection: purposive: clear introduction control, normalization-heavy theorem, conditional proof-summary comparison

cases.rationale: Both preserve the supplied claims and offer small, offsetting referent or sentence-level improvements. A's explicit specialization and B's explicit conjecture do not establish a material overall readability difference.

Neither version changes the supplied theorem or its delicate normalization conventions. A makes small local syntactic improvements; B makes the attribution paragraph more direct. These editorial differences do not produce a material overall preference.

Both preserve the supplied mathematics, and neither has a detected introduced error. A has a modest readability advantage because it explicitly states the unboundedness already supplied in the context and connects both estimates to that sequence. This is not a mathematical-defect judgment against B.

limits: This is independent AI review, not human review or formal verification.

Only RUBRIC.md and the nine supplied source/A/B files in this masked-review folder were inspected before writing these reports. No outside directory, writer notes, skill instructions, prompts, assignment key, or web source was inspected.
The assessments concern fidelity to supplied author assertions and research-mathematician readability. They do not certify the source manuscripts, original PDFs, theorem proofs, or references.
No introduced mathematical defect was detected in these six rewrites. This bounded finding is not a guarantee that no error exists.
Readability judgments are qualitative. No seven-metric percentages, human preferences, or empirical performance measurements are claimed.
Three selected excerpts and one run per condition; no statistical or general superiority claim.
Same inherited model configuration for writers and reviewer; correlated model-family bias is possible.
Condition labels were withheld; output style could still reveal a condition.
No human reader study, full-paper evaluation, proof certification, or inter-rater reliability study.
Source PDFs were visually checked for transcription fidelity by the primary agent; that is not independent verification.

The evaluated instruction snapshot is archived locally. After review, a pilot-report cross-link and a scoring-helper input-type validation fix were added; the manuscript-rewriting instructions were not edited.
raw_artifacts: Preserved in the local ignored evaluation archive; source excerpts and raw rewrites are not bundled in this public summary.
